correctness.rationale: The hat-function Gram matrix is G=(2dI+A)/6 with d=m(r-1). Direct multiplication proves its exact inverse has diagonal X/T, same-part off-diagonal 1/T, across-part -2/T, T=m^2(r-1)(2r-3), X=3m(2r-3)+1. Its kernel edge types are incident (X,-2), same-part-adjacent (1,-2), and external (-2,-2); their exact absolute integrals give the stated R. Since every projected function is affine on each edge, an L-infinity norming evaluation is a vertex. Kernel-sign inputs attain R. Algebra verifies R-2 sign regimes, monotonic m-increment, both limits, and negative kernel mass (R-1)/2. Independent direct SymPy Gram inversions and exact integrals at (m,r)=(1,2),(2,2),(3,2),(3,3),(2,4) agree; universal statement follows from matrix proof, not sample sizes.

value.rationale: Optimal max-norm amplification of an L2 projector is a standard stability invariant in spline/FEM analysis. The natural balanced branched graph family gives a complete two-parameter formula, exact sign extremizers, the sharp m=4 transition above 2, and an unattained universal 7/3 benchmark without pendant vertices. These are substantive approximation-instability boundaries, not mere routine plug-in numbers.
